categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Conglin Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in hazardous waste treatment, focusing on harmless disposal and resource utilization. The company provides integrated environmental protection services including waste incineration, landfill, chemical and physical treatment, and recycling of hazardous waste into valuable products. It also engages in environmental technology services and consulting.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed five core technology systems including waste organic solvent resource utilization, hazardous waste incineration with secondary pollution control, deep purification and recycling of copper-containing waste liquid, waste packaging container recycling, and low-cost coordinated treatment of incineration flue gas. It employs advanced processes such as quantum chemical simulation for solvent selection, ammonia thermal desorption, rotary kiln incineration with anti-coking technology, and automated liquid-state extraction systems. The company emphasizes technology innovation aligned with green, resource-efficient, digital, and intelligent development trends.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in information technology, high-end equipment, new materials, new energy, and biomedicine sectors such as SMIC, Huahong Semiconductor, China Commercial Aircraft, China Aviation Engine Group, Tesla Shanghai, WuXi AppTec, and Fudan Zhangjiang. The company also serves numerous universities and research institutions providing hazardous waste disposal services to support scientific research. The markets served are primarily industrial manufacturing sectors generating hazardous waste.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in Shanghai, Jiangsu, Shandong, Shanxi, and other economically developed regions. It has established five major production and operation bases across these regions. The company also strategically invests in projects in Guangxi and other provinces to expand its footprint. It participates in regional collaborative hazardous waste treatment initiatives in the Yangtze River Delta and other areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Conglin operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the hazardous waste management supply chain. It receives hazardous waste from upstream industrial manufacturers and provides treatment, disposal, and resource recovery services. It also sells recycled products derived from hazardous waste, thus integrating resource recycling into its business model.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in green, resource-efficient, digital, and intelligent hazardous waste treatment technologies. It focuses on improving resource recovery rates, reducing disposal costs, and developing high-value resource utilization technologies. The company maintains an open innovation system collaborating with universities and research institutes, with 14 ongoing R&D projects and continuous patent applications. It is also strategically expanding into bio-diesel new energy sectors aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through hazardous waste treatment service fees, including harmless disposal and resource utilization services. For waste with recycling value, the company charges treatment fees and also earns income from selling recycled products such as organic solvents, inorganic salts, base oils, heavy metals, and packaging containers. Some high-value waste may involve payment to waste producers. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's hazardous waste treatment industry, distinguished by its comprehensive technology portfolio and integrated service model. It competes in a fragmented and highly competitive market with over 3,600 hazardous waste treatment units nationwide. The company leverages its advanced technologies, extensive geographic coverage, and strong customer relationships to maintain a competitive edge. Industry consolidation favors large-scale, technologically advanced firms like Conglin.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 595 million, a 6.22% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 90 million, a 1.88% increase. Total assets stood at RMB 3.18 billion with equity of RMB 2.67 billion. The company maintains stable cash flows and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology development. Despite market pressures, it sustains profitability through cost control and efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Conglin emphasizes its integrated hazardous waste treatment ecosystem combining harmless disposal and resource utilization with advanced proprietary technologies. Its unique value lies in high-value resource recovery, cost-effective secondary pollution control, and comprehensive service offerings tailored to strategic emerging industries. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and collaboration with top research institutions differentiate it as a technology leader committed to sustainable environmental solutions and supporting national carbon neutrality goals.
